name: Homemaid Sweet Pea
original_name: ホームメイドスイートピー
source:
["Homemade" family made by a maid]

"It may have been temporary at first, but it can be a real family."

Verbena Manor is an unusual share house run by a maid.
There, the residents of Verbena Manor, including the main character, do not know the feeling of a happy family that everyone normally has.
This work is a story about them "living as a true family even though they were born differently and have different relations."

[Translated from https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/silkysall_0040/?utm_medium=dmm_affiliate&utm_source=nanarin0123-001]
translation:
[由女仆亲手打造的“自制”家庭]

“起初或许只是暂时凑在一起，但也可以成为真正的家人。”

马鞭草庄是一座由女仆经营的特别合租公寓。
包括主人公在内，住在这里的人，都未曾体会过常人习以为常的家庭幸福。
本作讲述的，正是他们“即使出身各异、彼此关系不同，也要作为真正的家人共同生活”的故事。

[译自https://dlsoft.dmm.co.jp/detail/silkysall_0040/?utm_medium=dmm_affiliate&utm_source=nanarin0123-001]
